description: Sample test cases for Oracle Chat database operations

tests.name: create_and_list_chat
tests.expected: Chat appears in list with correct title and model

tests.name: add_and_retrieve_messages
tests.expected: Two messages returned in order, roles match

tests.name: pin_unpin_chat
tests.expected: Pinned chat appears first in list

tests.name: archive_excludes_from_list
tests.expected: Archived chat not in default list, appears in list_archived_chats()

tests.name: checkpoint_save_restore
tests.expected: Only original 3 messages remain after restore

tests.name: search_like_escaping
tests.expected: Only messages containing literal '100%' are matched, not all messages

tests.name: duplicate_chat
tests.expected: New chat has same 3 messages, different chat_id
